<div class="calcicon-welcome"></div><h3>Free Online Calculator Use
	<!-- start: SSI z_4_020_calc_tool_siteinfo_col_2.shtml --><!--
--></h3><p><!--
--><!-- end: SSI z_4_020_calc_tool_siteinfo_col_2.shtml -->
	Fast, free, eye-opening answers ... from a friend who's got your back.
	
	<!-- start: SSI z_4_025_calc_tool_siteinfo_col_3.shtml --><!--
--></p></div><div class="page-content-col-t2"><div style="padding:5%;"><!--
--><!-- end: SSI z_4_025_calc_tool_siteinfo_col_3.shtml -->
<h3>Why Use the Calculators On this Website?</h3><p>Don't you wish all sales presentations included a list of drawbacks, hidden costs, and less costly alternatives, so you could <strong>make wise financial decisions instantly?</strong></p><p>Sorry, but since marketing experts are only interested in selling as much of their own products and services as they can legally get away with, I'm afraid their sales presentations will never give you anything more than <strong>exaggerated benefits</strong> to base your decisions on.</p><h3>So Where Does That Leave You?</h3><p>It leaves you to make your buying, spending, and investing decisions based on exaggerated benefits with little or no knowledge of the untold hidden costs, drawbacks, and less costly alternatives.</p><p>So if you've been making your financial decisions based solely on sales presentations, guess who's been benefiting the most from your decisions? <strong>Sellers!</strong></p><h3>What Can You Do About It?</h3><p>Of course, you could take the time to meticulously research every single buying decision that comes up ... <strong>but who has time for that?!</strong></p><p>A more practical solution is to find a trusted source (<strong>someone who does not have a vested interest in the outcome of your financial decisions</strong>) who exposes the exaggerated benefits for what they are, and who helps you to become fully aware of the hidden costs, drawbacks, and less costly alternatives.</p><h3>My Financial Calculators Have Your Back</h3><p>In addition to providing numerical answers to your financial questions, the financial calculators on this site also attempt to expose exaggerated benefits for what they are and alert you to the hidden costs, drawbacks, and less costly alternatives that marketing experts don't include in their sales presentations.</p><p>The goal of these calculators is not to portray corporate marketing experts as being evil (they are just doing their jobs), nor is the goal to get you to buy certain products and services while turning down others.</p><p>Instead, the goal is to make you fully aware of the opportunity costs your decisions will create -- before you make them -- so you can make decisions that will serve <strong>your best interests</strong> instead of those of the seller.</p><h3>Why Did I Build This Site?</h3><p>In short, I built this website to attach a meaningful purpose to my long-standing passion. Please allow me to explain.</p><h4>My Passion</h4><p><strong>Building online calculators is my form of creative self-expression.</strong> I've been creating online calculators for websites since 1997, but it wasn't until September of 2010 that I chose to free myself from building calculators based on the specifications of others, and instead build them based on my own specifications and values.</p><h4>My Meaningful Purpose</h4><p><strong>Helping others to maximize the emotional returns on the money they earn.</strong> Having been duped into following a path that led to a financial crash and burn myself (you can <a data-ajax="false" data-link="focu" href="https://www.free-online-calculator-use.com/info-about-me.html" onclick="return FIX.track(this);">read my story here</a>), and having watched numerous friends and loved ones be led over the same financial cliff, I've made it my life's mission to expose the exaggerated benefits and hidden costs of spending, buying, and owning that marketing experts have been using to lure unsuspecting consumers away from the path to genuine happiness, and onto the path that leads consumers to being trapped by debt in a job they hate.</p><h3>The Magic Formula: VS + P + MP = GH</h3><p>Back when I let sellers do all my thinking for me, I had allowed myself to believe that the key to genuine happiness (GH) was to have more money and more things. Little did I know at the time that chasing after more money and more things can only lead to unhappiness.</p><p>Why? Because chasing after money rarely leads anyone to having the financial freedom to work at what they love, for a cause they truly believe in. In fact, more often than not, chasing after more money leads to the exact opposite: being trapped by debt in a job you hate.</p><p>Lucky for me, I eventually hit a financial bottom hard enough to cause me to question what I had been taught and who had been doing the teaching.</p><p>After much self-reflection and soul searching I eventually discovered that the key to genuine happiness (<strong>GH</strong>) is to be of valuable service to others (<strong>VS</strong>), doing a work that you are passionate about (<strong>P</strong>), that serves a meaningful purpose (<strong>MP</strong>).</p><p>The most amazing thing I discovered is, if you solve for the VS, P, and MP variables in the Genuine Happiness equation -- <strong>the money tends to chase after you</strong> instead of the other way around.</p><h3>Are You Trying To Solve a Flawed Formula?</h3><p>If you're not being of valuable service to others, and you don't love your work, and your work is not attached to a meaningful purpose, then there's a good chance you're trying to solve an equation designed to serve the interests of the marketing experts who gave you the flawed formula in the first place.</p><p>If that's the case, then my goal is to help you to stop chasing after money and possessions and encourage you to discover and pursue a work that you love (well suited to your talents, genuine interests, personality traits, and personal values), and then to find a way to attach a meaningful purpose to that work.</p><p>To get you started on that path ...</p><h3>Don't Miss These Life Changing Calculators</h3><p>Regardless of how or why you happened upon this website, please don't leave before studying the eye-opening lessons on these three calculators. Once you fully grasp the concepts introduced in these calculators you should <strong>instantly begin making financial decisions that will generate more happiness for less money</strong>.</p><div class="callout-box-a"><ul class="my-listview"><li><strong><a data-ajax="false" data-link="focu" href="https://www.free-online-calculator-use.com/time-value-calculator.html" onclick="return FIX.track(this);">The Real Value of Your Time</a></strong></li><li><strong><a data-ajax="false" data-link="focu" href="https://www.free-online-calculator-use.com/time-value-of-money-calculator.html" onclick="return FIX.track(this);">The Hidden Costs of Expendables</a></strong></li><li><strong><a data-ajax="false" data-link="focu" href="https://www.free-online-calculator-use.com/time-value-money-calculator.html" onclick="return FIX.track(this);">The Hidden Costs of Depreciables</a></strong></li></ul></div><h3>But Why the Non-Financial Calculators?</h3><p>While the math, conversion, date, and weight-loss calculators don't directly serve my meaningful purpose, I am including these non-financial calculators for two reasons.</p><ol class="my-listview"><li>Because no matter who visits this website, or what their interests are, everyone is making financial decisions every hour of every day. In other words, I include the non-financial calculators to expand the size of the audience I hope to serve.</li><li>Because any time I run across a problem someone is trying to solve, I can't help but want to try to create an online calculator to help solve it. It's what I love to do!</li></ol><h3>What Else Makes My Calculators Unique?</h3><p>Unlike other online calculator web sites, the calculators on this site ...</p><ul class="my-listview"><li>are free to use, and don't require you to log-in or register!</li><li>are created by one author, making them uniform and easier to use.</li><li>don't require you to download and update special software.</li><li>operate on a single page, no waiting for result pages to load!</li><li>recalculate on the same page, no need to keep clicking the Back button.</li><li>don't attempt to collect or store your personal information.</li><li>are created with your best interests at heart.</li></ul><h3>Thank You!</h3><p>Thank you for visiting my website. Your feedback is very important to me, so please <a data-ajax="false" data-link="focu" href="https://www.free-online-calculator-use.com/info-contact-me.html" onclick="return FIX.track(this);">contact me</a> and let me how I'm doing and what I might do better to help you to maximize the emotional returns on the money you earn.</p> <!-- start: SSI z_4_030_calc_tool_siteinfo_col_4.shtml --><!--
--></div><!--
--><!-- end: SSI z_4_030_calc_tool_siteinfo_col_4.shtml -->

class="mob-page-header" id="mob-glossary-page-header"><div class="calcicon-magnify tab-header-image-div"></div><h3 id="glossary-tab-header-title">User Guide</h3><p>How to use this onclick="show_hide_collapsible(this.id)" title="Click to expand or collapse.">Site Menu Button</div><div class="collapsible-content" id="site-menu-btn-collapsible-content"><ul class="my-listview"><li>Located in the upper left-hand corner of the window.</li><li><span class="clicking-tapping-upper"></span> this button should slide out a scrollable <em>Menu</em> from left. <a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="load_menu_panel()"><span class="click-tap-upper"></span> here</a> to open it.</li><li>If you expand the <em>Search Calculator Titles</em> section and start typing in the search field, a list should be appear, populated with button links to any calculators that match the character string you typed.</li><li><span class="clicking-tapping-upper"></span> a menu heading containing a plus (+) icon should expand the links it contains (e.g., Top Ten ...). Clicking or tapping a minus (-) icon should collapse the list.</li><li>The Menu contains three category headings:	<ul><li>Financial Calculators</li><li>Other Calculators</li><li>Site Information</li></ul><span class="clicking-tapping-upper"></span> the button links beneath the headings will take you to that page.</li><li><span class="click-tap-upper"></span> the <em>Close</em> button to hide the menu.</li></ul></div><div class="collapsible-header ui-btn-icon-left ui-icon-plus ui-btn-c" data-role="collapsible" id="favorites-btn-collapsible" onclick="show_hide_collapsible(this.id)" title="Click to expand or collapse.">Favorites Button</div><div class="collapsible-content" id="favorites-btn-collapsible-content"><p>If you are using the latest version of your preferred web browser software (and one that supports <em>Local Storage</em>), this feature allows you quickly navigate to your favorite calculators on the site.</p><div class="local-storage-support-msg"><div class="callout-box-a"><strong>Yay!</strong> It appears your web browser does support <em>Local Storage</em>.</div></div><ul class="my-listview"><li>Located in the upper left-hand corner of the window ("Favs" on smartphones).</li><li><span class="clicking-tapping-upper"></span> this button should slide out a scrollable <em>Favorites</em> panel from left. <a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="openPanel('favs_panel')"><span class="click-tap-upper"></span> here</a> to open it.</li><li><span class="click-tap-upper"></span> the <em>Add</em> button to add the page you are on to your Favorites list.</li><li><span class="click-tap-upper"></span> the <em>Remove</em> button to remove the page you are on from your Favorites list.</li><li><span class="click-tap-upper"></span> the button links under <em>My Favorites</em> to go to that page.</li><li><span class="click-tap-upper"></span> or tap the <em>Close Favorites</em> button to hide the Favorites panel.</li></ul></div><div class="collapsible-header ui-btn-icon-left ui-icon-plus ui-btn-c" data-role="collapsible" id="save-feature-collapsible" onclick="show_hide_collapsible(this.id)" title="Click to expand or collapse.">Saving Entries and Notes</div><div class="collapsible-content" id="save-feature-collapsible-content"><h4>What</h4><p>If you are using the latest version of your preferred web browser software (and one that supports <em>Local Storage</em>), this feature allows you to save your entries in between visits.</p><div class="local-storage-support-msg"><div class="callout-box-a"><strong>Yay!</strong> It appears your web browser does support <em>Local Storage</em>.</div></div><h4>Why</h4><p>If you have wanted to use one of my more entry intensive calculators (budgeting, consolidation, etc.), but you don't have time to complete all of the entries, you can now save what you have and pick up where you left off on your next visit.</p><h4>How</h4><p>On each calculator page you will see a tab labeled "Data" (under the page header on small-screen devices, right column on wide-screen devices).</p><p><span class="clicking-tapping-upper"></span> <em>Data</em> tab will display a form wherein you can save named sets of entries for the calculator, as well any notes and ideas that come to mind while using the calculator.</p><p>To backup your saved entries in case they get lost, the "Data" form includes a button labeled "Backup Data". <span class="clicking-tapping-upper"></span> this button will expand a form wherein you can load your data into a text field. You can then copy the data and save it to a text-only document (Notepad on Windows or TextEdit on Mac) on your hard drive. That way, if your data goes missing, you can reload your data from your saved backup file. You can also use this <em>Backup</em> feature to transfer your saved data on the free site, to the <a data-link="focu" href="https://www.free-online-calculator-use.com/info-ad-free-version.html" onclick="return FIX.track(this);">Ad-Free Member Version</a>.</p><p>Please refer to the "Help and Tools" instructions on a given calculator page for more specific instructions.</p><h4>Disclaimer</h4><p>Since your entries and notes are saved to your web browser on your device ...</p><ul class="my-listview"><li>You can only recall the saved entries and notes while using the same device and web browser you were using when you saved them.</li><li>I don't have access to your stored entries and notes for troubleshooting purposes.</li><li>If you upgrade your web browser, your saved notes and entries may be lost.</li></ul></div><div class="collapsible-header ui-btn-icon-left ui-icon-plus ui-btn-c" data-role="collapsible" id="calc-prefs-feature-collapsible" onclick="show_hide_collapsible(this.id)" title="Click to expand or collapse.">Calculator Preferences</div><div class="collapsible-content" id="calc-prefs-feature-collapsible-content"><p>Just above each calculator is a button labeled "Calculator Preferences". <span class="clicking-tapping-upper"></span> this button will expand the preferences options, which vary depending on the width of your screen:</p><p><strong>Small and Large Screen Preferences</strong></p><ul class="my-listview"><li><em>Show/Hide Keypads:</em> <p>On small screens, each numeric entry field is followed by a grid icon. <span class="clicking-tapping-upper"></span> the icon will open a popup entry form designed for devices that don't include decimal points in their numeric keypads. This preference allows you to <em>Show</em> or <em>Hide</em> the grid icons.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Large Screen Only Preferences</strong></p><ul class="my-listview"><li><em>Adjust Calculator Width:</em> <p>Move the slider left and right to decrease or increase the width of the calculator to suit your preferences.</p> <p>Note that some calculators will display a mobile optimized form at narrow calculator widths, and a desktop optimized form for wider calculator widths.</p> <p>Also note that if you set the calculator to a very wide width, the "Help and Tools" panel will be hidden from view (useful if the "Help and Tools" panel is overlapping part of the calculator).</p></li><li><em>Stick/Unstick Tools:</em> <p>If you would like to stop the "Help and Tools" panel from staying in view as you scroll the page, choose the <em>Unstick</em> preference.</p></li></ul><p></p></div><div class="collapsible-header ui-btn-icon-left ui-icon-plus ui-btn-c" data-role="collapsible" id="dashboard-feature-collapsible" onclick="show_hide_collapsible(this.id)" title="Click to expand or collapse.">My Dashboard</div><div class="collapsible-content" id="dashboard-feature-collapsible-content"><p>If you are using the latest version of your preferred web browser software (and one that supports <em>Local Storage</em>), your <a data-link="focu" href="https://www.free-online-calculator-use.com/my-dashboard.html" onclick="return FIX.track(this);">Dashboard</a> allows you to view all of the following on one page.</p><div class="local-storage-support-msg"><div class="callout-box-a"><strong>Yay!</strong> It appears your web browser does support <em>Local Storage</em>.</div></div><ul class="my-listview"><li>Links to all of your <em>Favorites</em>.</li><li>All of your saved notes.</li><li>Links to all calculator that have saved entries.</li></ul></div><div class="collapsible-header ui-btn-icon-left ui-icon-plus ui-btn-c" data-role="collapsible" id="ad-free-feature-collapsible" onclick="show_hide_collapsible(this.id)" title="Click to expand or collapse.">Ad-Free Member Version</div><div class="collapsible-content" id="ad-free-feature-collapsible-content"><p>If you'd like to use an uncluttered, lightening fast version of this website, I invite you to subscribe to <strong>Ad-Free Member Version</strong>, which offers 2 levels.</p><h4><em>Basic</em> Level</h4><p>Same as the free version you are using now, but without the ads. Cost: $6.97 per year.</p><h4><em>Cloud</em> Level</h4><p>This version saves your entries and notes to a secure online database. This means ...</p><ul class="my-listview"><li>You can access your saved entries and notes from any device or web browser.</li><li>I have access to your saved data for troubleshooting purposes.</li><li>I back up your data on a regular basis.</li></ul><p>The cost for the <em>Cloud</em> version is $12.97 per year.</p><p><a href="https://www.ahacalcs.com/member/signup" onclick="return FIX.track(this);">Subscribe Here</a> or <a data-link="focu" href="https://www.free-online-calculator-use.com/info-ad-free-version.html" onclick="return FIX.track(this);">get complete details here</a>.</p></div></div></div><div style="margin-top:20px;"><a class="ui-btn ui-btn-c ui-btn-icon-left ui-icon-carat-l ui-corner-all" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="open_mobile_page('calc')">Back to Main Page</a></div></div></div></div><div data-role="page" data-theme="a" id="mob-pcalc-page" style="display:none;"><div class="my-content-padding" --><aside class="sidenav" id="favs_panel"><div class="sidenav-header" id="favs-panel-header"><button class="ui-btn ui-icon-carat-l ui-btn-icon-left ui-shadow-icon ui-btn-c ui-corner-all ui-mini ui-btn-inline" data-focu="page-btn" onclick="closePanel('favs_panel')" type="button">Close Favorites</button></div><div class="ui-body ui-body-c" style="background-color:white;padding:1px 0 0 0;"><div class="tab-header" id="favs-tab-header"><div class="calcicon-serving tab-header-image-div"></div><h4 id="favs-tab-header-title">Favorites</h4><p>Add or remove this page to/from my favorites.</p></div><div id="favs-tab-content"><div class="ui-bar" style="text-align:center;"><form action="#" id="favorites_form" method="post" name="favorites_form"><div data-mini="true" data-role="controlgroup" data-type="horizontal"><button class="ui-btn ui-icon-gear ui-corner-all ui-btn-e ui-mini ui-btn-inline" data-focu="calc-btn" onclick="add_to_favs()" type="button">Add</button><button class="ui-btn ui-icon-gear ui-corner-all ui-btn-e ui-mini ui-btn-inline" data-focu="calc-btn" onclick="delete_from_favs()" type="button">Remove</button></div></form></div><div class="panel-msg" id="favorites_msg"></div><div class="panel-content-scroll" id="favorites_list" style="height: 400px;"></div></div></div></aside><div class="non-clc-tt-div" id="tt-calc-width-pref-popup"><h4 class="tt-title">Adjust Calculator Width:</h4><div class="tt-explain"><p>Move the slider to left and right to adjust the calculator width. Note that the <em>Help and Tools</em> panel will be hidden when the calculator is too wide to fit both on the screen. Moving the slider to the left will bring the instructions and tools panel back into view.</p><p>Also note that some calculators will reformat to accommodate the screen size as you make the calculator wider or narrower. If the calculator is narrow, columns of entry rows will be converted to a vertical entry form, whereas a wider calculator will display columns of entry rows, and the entry fields will be smaller in size ... since they will not need to be "thumb friendly".</p></div></div><div class="non-clc-tt-div" id="tt-keypad-popup-pref-popup"><h4 class="tt-title">Show/Hide Popup Keypads:</h4><div class="tt-explain"><p>Select <strong>Show</strong> or <strong>Hide</strong> to show or hide the popup keypad icons located next to numeric entry fields. These are generally only needed for mobile devices that don't have decimal points in their numeric keypads. So if you are on a desktop, you may find the calculator to be more user-friendly and less cluttered without them.</p></div></div><div class="non-clc-tt-div" id="tt-tools-sticky-pref-popup"><h4 class="tt-title">Stick/Unstick Tools:</h4><div class="tt-explain"><p>Select <strong>Stick</strong> or <strong>Unstick</strong> to stick or unstick the help and tools panel. Selecting "Stick" will keep the panel in view while scrolling the calculator vertically. If you find that annoying, select "Unstick" to keep the panel in a stationary position.</p><p>If the tools panel becomes "Unstuck" on its own, try clicking "Unstick" and then "Stick" to re-stick the panel.</p></div></div><!--
